data.name: SettingsAnimateTrayIconDesc

data.name: PrivacyPreviewNote
data.value: This preview sends no data and fetches no announcements, so there is nothing to turn off here.

data.name: UpdatesCheckDesc
data.value: Every 6 hours, asks this project's GitHub releases whether a newer version is out. Only your IP address and the app's version reach GitHub. Updates install only when you choose Update now, and only if their signature checks out.

data.name: UpdateCheckFailed
data.value: Couldn't reach GitHub. Try again later.

data.name: UpdateNotificationBody
data.value: Click here to install it. It asks first, and your settings stay.

data.name: SettingsNotifyUpdates
data.value: Show a notification when an update is out

data.name: SettingsNotifyUpdatesDesc
data.value: A Windows notification, once per new version; Do not disturb holds it back. The flyout and the tray menu still show the update.
